frequency_question: What proportion of major partisan federal election bills pass the Senate within a comparable timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes major standalone federal legislation targeting voter registration, ballot access, or election administration that aligns with a major party platform and faces strong partisan division; excludes routine funding bills and bipartisan compromises.

cases.name: Help America Vote Act (bipartisan subset, excluded)
Freedom to Vote Act / For the People Act

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major partisan electoral bills/vehicles; believed to represent the total relevant modern universe of highly contested federal voting bills under similar legislative friction.
known_gaps: Older historical iterations of federal franchise laws from the mid-20th century are excluded due to radically different filibuster and party alignment dynamics.
validity_reason: Remains valid as long as Senate filibuster rules and extreme partisan polarization on election administration persist.
